front.title: The 'imc' URI Scheme for Bundle Protocol Multicast

abstract.t: This document defines the 'imc' URI scheme, a concise integer-based scheme for identifying Bundle Protocol Version 7 (BPv7) endpoints that are not singleton endpoints, termed multicast endpoints. The structure of 'imc' URIs mirrors that of the 'ipn' URI scheme: each 'imc' URI comprises an Allocator Identifier, a Group Number, and a Service Number. This document specifies the textual syntax of 'imc' URIs, their interpretation when used as BPv7 Endpoint Identifiers, their CBOR encoding, and the corresponding EID Pattern, and requests the associated IANA registrations.
